props.text: Macro BTC positioning analysis shared: dovish catalyst spent; no bullish driver until Jackson Hole (Aug 27-29) or Sept jobs print. Expect range-and-flush behavior with elevated vol. Patient bid zones: 61.8-62.0K, 60.0-60.7K. Fed with no forward guidance + contested September = structurally higher-vol regime.
Aligns with group consolidation thesis (HCH 62K TP plan, KillaXBT Jackson Hole catalyst awareness). Macro framework validation.
